get.description: Given one or more lookup keys, returns a joined view across owners, Qualys, Security Central, and BugDB. Provide at least one of service, ownerEmail, bug, cve, qid. Each key accepts multiple values — repeat the param (?service=a&service=b) or pass a comma-separated list (?service=a,b) — so you can enrich a whole batch in one request instead of one at a time. cve is substring match (matches any supplied value); others are exact IN (...) matches. BugDB records are matched by the supplied keys and by any bug IDs discovered in the Qualys/Security Central results. The `query` field echoes each key back as an array of the supplied values.
